pairs.target: yǔ luòxiàlái de shíhòu , shào lǐ gāng bǎ báiqī shàng de bàngè zì cā chūlái .

pairs.target: gù shīfu ràng tā tíngshǒu , yòng zhǐjiǎ dàxiǎo de yìzhāng báozhǐ bǐ zhe quēkǒu , dītóu kàn le hěn jiǔ .

pairs.hanzi: 不是在找暗号。

pairs.target: bùzi shàng yǒu jiù hào , yě yǒu yuánlái fàngzhì de wèizhì , tā dé xiān quèrèn yǎnqián zhè sāngēn , quèshí jiùshì qùnián jiǎnchá guò de nà sāngēn .

pairs.target: tā bǎ bùzi zhuǎngěi tuīchē de nǚrén . "

她把簿子转给推车的女人。
“

pairs.target: nǚrén méi kàn bùzi , xiān bǎ zìjǐ de dānzi tān zài pángbiān .
pairs.english: The woman didn't look at the log; first she spread her own slip beside it.

她那张只抄到“转用”，下面接着便是数量，空白处还能放下好几行字。

pairs.target: shào lǐ shēntóu kàn le yìyǎn , shuō zì búshì tā de .

pairs.hanzi: 邵里伸头看了一眼，说字不是他的。

pairs.target: tā lái zhèlǐ shí , zhè zhāng dānzi yǐjīng jiá zài dàibàn de cè lǐ .
pairs.english: When he'd arrived here, the slip was already tucked into the pending-work book.
pairs.hanzi: 他来这里时，这张单子已经夹在待办的册里。

pairs.target: tuīchē de nánrén xiào le , xiào dé bǐ màrén hái nántīng . "
pairs.english: The carter laughed, a laugh uglier than abuse.
pairs.hanzi: 推车的男人笑了，笑得比骂人还难听。“

pairs.target: zì búshì nǐ de , huà búshì tā shuō de , zuìhòu chē shì wǒmen tuī de . "

pairs.hanzi: 字不是你的，话不是她说的，最后车是我们推的。”

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zǒu dào ménbiān , wèn néngfǒu bǎ zhè liǎngzhāng bùtóng de jìfǎ gè chāo yífèn .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey came to the door and asked to copy both differing versions.

pairs.target: gù shīfu shuō kěyǐ , tái shǒuzhǐ le zhǐ yánxià , jiào xuéshēng zài gān chù xiě , bié bǎ yuánjiàn lín huài .
pairs.english: Master Gu agreed, pointing under the eaves and telling the students to write somewhere dry, keeping the originals out of the rain.

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu bǎ huàtí chà dào xuéshēng shēnshàng . "
pairs.english: She didn't divert the conversation to the students.
pairs.hanzi:
她没有把话题岔到学生身上。
“

pairs.english: “This copy left something out. We failed to explain when we called you here,” she told the woman.
pairs.hanzi: 这张抄漏了，叫你们跑来，是我们这里没讲明白。”她对女人说，“

pairs.target: dàn zhè jǐgēn bùnéng zhèyàng shàng wūdǐng . " "
pairs.english: “But these pieces can't go on the roof like that.”
pairs.hanzi:
但这几根不能这样上屋顶。”
“

pairs.target: nà wǒmen ná shénme gài ? "
pairs.english: “Then what do we roof it with?”
pairs.hanzi: 那我们拿什么盖？”

pairs.target: gù shīfu kàn le yìyǎn shānsè , méiyǒu shuō hěnkuài jiù néng tì tāmen zhǎo lái .
pairs.english: Master Gu glanced at the mountains, without promising to find replacements soon.
pairs.hanzi: 顾师傅看了一眼山色，没有说很快就能替他们找来。

pairs.target: tā wèn yuánlái de mù liáng huài dào nǎ yíbù , tīng wán yòu jiào rén qù kàn ,
pairs.english: She asked how badly the original wooden beams had deteriorated, then sent someone to inspect them,

pairs.target: yāoqiú zài dòng gàibǎn yǐqián , bǎ línshí zhīchēng yě chá le .

pairs.hanzi: 要求在动盖板以前，把临时支撑也查了。

pairs.target: nǚrén wèn fèiyòng jì gěi shuí , tā shuō xiān jì zhàn lǐ de cháyàn gōng , búràng tāmen lìng zhǎo rén fù zhè yítàng .
pairs.english: The woman asked who would pay; she said to charge this inspection to the station, not make them hire someone for this trip.
pairs.hanzi: 女人问费用记给谁，她说先记站里的查验工，不让他们另找人付这一趟。

pairs.target: zhèhuà ràng nánrén shōuqǐ le liǎnshàng de xiào , què méiyǒu ràng tā gāoxìng .
pairs.english: That wiped the smile from the man's face, but didn't make him happy.
pairs.hanzi: 这话让男人收起了脸上的笑，却没有让他高兴。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bèijiào qù chāo jiù jìlù .
pairs.english: Tavi was called to copy the old record.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维被叫去抄旧记录。

pairs.target: zhǐ shàng de zì hěnxiǎo , jiá zhe jǐcì bùtóng rén de qiānmíng .
pairs.english: The writing was small, interspersed with several different signatures.
pairs.hanzi: 纸上的字很小，夹着几次不同人的签名。

pairs.target: qùnián cháyàn shí , sāngēn tiě zhī zhǔn yòngyú cèmiàn ;
pairs.english: Last year's inspection permitted only side use for all three irons;
pairs.hanzi: 去年查验时，三根铁只准用于侧面；

pairs.target: jīnnián dēngjì lǐ , yǒu yíchù kǒng biān xiùshí kuòdà , lián jiù yòngtú yě yào fùhé .
pairs.english: this year's register recorded widening corrosion at one hole, requiring reassessment even for the old use.
pairs.hanzi: 今年登记里，有一处孔边锈蚀扩大，连旧用途也要复核。

pairs.target: tā yuányǐwéi gù shīfu fān chū lòudiào de bànjù , shìqíng jiù huì qīngchǔ ,
pairs.english: He had thought everything would be clear once Master Gu found the missing half-sentence.
pairs.hanzi: 他原以为顾师傅翻出漏掉的半句，事情就会清楚，

pairs.target: xiànzài què fāxiàn qīngchǔ le yě bù děngyú néng bǎ chē zhuāngmǎn .
pairs.english: Now he found that clarity didn't mean the cart could be filled.
pairs.hanzi: 现在却发现清楚了也不等于能把车装满。

pairs.target: dé mǎ chāo nà zhāng dānzi , chāo dào kòngbáichù shí tíng le bǐ , zài pángbiān zhùmíng yuánjiàn dàocǐwéizhǐ .
pairs.english: Dema copied the slip, stopping at the blank space to note that the original ended there.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn tā yòu qùhé le yíbiàn shùliàng , zìjǐ yě dītóu bǎ jiù hào chóngxīn duì le yícì .
pairs.english: Tavi saw her check the quantity again, and bent his head to recheck the old numbers himself.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见她又去核了一遍数量，自己也低头把旧号重新对了一次。

pairs.target: nǚrén gé zhe zhuōzi wàng zhe tāmen .

pairs.hanzi: 女人隔着桌子望着他们。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng shuō cháng dé xiàng búshì yíyàng , huàdàozuǐbiān , xiān kànjiàn tā zhǐjié shàng de lièkǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to say looking alike wasn't being the same, but first he noticed the cracks on her knuckles.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想说长得像不是一样，话到嘴边，先看见她指节上的裂口。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐ ànzhù , huàn le gè wèn fǎ . "
pairs.english: Holding the paper down, he asked a different question.
pairs.hanzi:
他把纸按住，换了个问法。
“

pairs.target: nàgēn xiànzài fàngzài nǎlǐ ? " "
pairs.english: “Where is that piece now?”
pairs.hanzi:
那根现在放在哪里？”
“

pairs.target: péng nánbiān , lā zhù liǎnggēn zhùzi . "
pairs.english: “South of the shed, holding two posts together.”
pairs.hanzi: 棚南边，拉住两根柱子。”

pairs.target: tā shuō zhīdào le , yòu juéde zhè jù huà tàikōng ,
pairs.english: He said he understood, then felt how empty that sounded,
pairs.hanzi: 他说知道了，又觉得这句话太空，

pairs.target: biàn bǎ gù shīfu gāngcái zhǐ guò de wèizhì huà zài zhǐbiān .
pairs.english: so he sketched at the paper's edge the position Master Gu had just indicated.
pairs.hanzi: 便把顾师傅刚才指过的位置画在纸边。

pairs.target: nǚrén kànzhe , zhōngyú bǎ zìjǐ de dānzi nuó jìn xiē , wèn shìbushì shù zhe de dìfāng néng yòng , héng zhe de jiù bùxíng . "
pairs.english: Watching, the woman finally moved her slip closer and asked whether vertical use was allowed but horizontal use wasn't.
pairs.hanzi:
女人看着，终于把自己的单子挪近些，问是不是竖着的地方能用，横着的就不行。
“

pairs.english: “You can't judge only by horizontal or vertical either,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi: 也不能只看横竖。”塔维说，“

pairs.english: “I'm afraid I'll explain it wrongly. We need her to tell you.”
pairs.hanzi: 我怕给你讲错，得请她说。”

pairs.target: zhècì nǚrén méiyǒu xiào tā .

pairs.hanzi: 这次女人没有笑他。

pairs.target: gù shīfu huílái hòu , tǎ wéi bǎ wèntí zhuǎnguò qù , zìjǐ ràngchū zhuōbiān de wèizhì .

pairs.target: tā ná liǎnggēn mùtiáo , bǎi chū cè lā hé tuōzhù wūdǐng de chābié ,
pairs.english: Using two wooden strips, she demonstrated the difference between a lateral tie and supporting a roof,
pairs.hanzi: 她拿两根木条，摆出侧拉和托住屋顶的差别，

pairs.target: yòu shuōmíng xiù kǒng de wèntí shì lìng yíjiàn shì , búshì gǎi gè fāngxiàng jiù xiāoshī .
pairs.english: then explained the corroded hole was a separate problem, not something that disappeared with a change of direction.

pairs.target: yǔ jiànjiàn mì le .

pairs.hanzi: 雨渐渐密了。

pairs.target: lái chá péng de rén dàihuí xiāoxī , yuányǒu mù liáng de duāntóu shī làn , xūyào zànshí jiā chēng ,
pairs.english: The shed inspector returned: the original wooden beams had wet rot at their ends and needed temporary props;
pairs.hanzi: 来查棚的人带回消息，原有木梁的端头湿烂，需要暂时加撑，

pairs.target: bùnéng jīntiān jiù bǎ zhěngpiàn gàibǎn jiēdiào .
pairs.english: the whole section of roof panels couldn't be lifted today.
pairs.hanzi: 不能今天就把整片盖板揭掉。

pairs.target: chēshàng de cǎodiàn bèi ná xiàlái diàn zài chángdèng dǐxià , liǎnggè bānggōng zuò zhe děng xià yíbù ānpái .

pairs.target: gù shīfu chóngxīn hé guò shùliàng , gěi zhè yìpī kāi le chūkù dān .

pairs.target: shéngjié yóu tuīchē de nánrén zìjǐ xì , tā xì wán yòu lā le liǎngxià , zhōngyú shuō le shēng xièxiè , bù zhīdào shì duì shuí .
pairs.english: The carter tied the knots himself and tugged them twice, finally saying thank you, though it wasn't clear to whom.

pairs.target: wǔ xiē shí , shào lǐ cóng xiǎowū náchū liǎngzhī wǎn , gěi tǎ wéi fēn le yíbàn rètāng .
pairs.english: At the midday break, Shaoli brought two bowls from the little room and shared half his hot soup with Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 午歇时，邵里从小屋拿出两只碗，给塔维分了一半热汤。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén zuòzài ménkǎn biān , xīgài shàng hái zhān zhe bān liào de huī . "
pairs.english: They sat beside the threshold, knees still dusty from moving the material.
pairs.hanzi:
两个人坐在门槛边，膝盖上还沾着搬料的灰。
“

pairs.target: biàntiáo shōudào le . " shào lǐ shuō , " jīntiān běnlái xiǎng zǎo shōugōng . nǐ kànjiàn le . "
pairs.english: “Got your note,” Shaoli said. “I hoped to finish early today. You saw how that went.”
pairs.hanzi: 便条收到了。”邵里说，“今天本来想早收工。你看见了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tíqǐ suànshù cè , wèn néng bunéng zài liú yízhèn .

pairs.hanzi: 塔维提起算术册，问能不能再留一阵。

pairs.target: shào lǐ shuō kěyǐ , guòxiētiān zìjǐ yě yào yòngdào hòumiàn de jǐzhāng biǎo , dào shí chāo yífèn jiù xíng .
pairs.english: Shaoli agreed; he'd need some tables near the back in a few days, but a copy would do.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里说可以，过些天自己也要用到后面的几张表，到时抄一份就行。

pairs.target: tā méi wèn xué dé hǎobuhǎo , zhī wèn nà yè cuò dáàn gǎi le méiyǒu . "
pairs.english: He didn't ask how well Tavi was learning, only whether he'd corrected that page's wrong answer.
pairs.hanzi:
他没问学得好不好，只问那页错答案改了没有。
“

pairs.target: gǎi le . nǐ xiě de zì tàixiǎo , wǒ chàdiǎn bǎ zìjǐ de yě gǎicuò . "
pairs.english: “I did. Your writing's so small I nearly made my own answer wrong too.”
pairs.hanzi: 改了。你写的字太小，我差点把自己的也改错。”

pairs.target: shào lǐ hē zhe tāng xiào qǐlái .
pairs.english: Shaoli laughed over his soup.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里喝着汤笑起来。

pairs.target: yán wài de chē yǐjīng zǒu le , lún yìn lǐ mànmàn jī qǐ shuǐ .
pairs.english: The cart beyond the eaves had gone; water slowly filled its wheel ruts.
pairs.hanzi: 檐外的车已经走了，轮印里慢慢积起水。

pairs.target: tāmen shuí yě méiyǒu bǎ jīntiān shuō chéng bàn dé hěn hǎo .
pairs.english: Neither called the day a great success.
pairs.hanzi: 他们谁也没有把今天说成办得很好。

pairs.target: shào lǐ bǎ wǎndǐ de cài bō dào zuǐlǐ , qǐshēn qù huàn ménbiān nà zhāng tōngzhī :
pairs.english: Shaoli scooped the last vegetables into his mouth, then rose to change the notice beside the door:
pairs.hanzi: 邵里把碗底的菜拨到嘴里，起身去换门边那张通知：
